messages:
priya: Opening a PR for an "offsite signing" workflow for HSM-backed KMS in Private installs. Goal: document an air-gapped intermediate CA signing flow where CSRs are signed on an isolated signing host, keys are imported to HSMs, and certs are staged to nodes via USB or jumpbox. Draft branch: docs/offsite-signing. Need: step-by-step checklist, example commands for CSR/signing, a SoftHSM pkcs11 example and one generic vendor note, atomic install systemd unit + install script outline, rollback steps, and a short migration blurb for v1.2 -> v1.3. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/498

ben: nice. can you include a short section about CRL generation + distribution for completely offline customers? also include firewall/host hardening notes (nftables vs iptables guidance) because ops often ask.

priya: draft snippet for CSR + offline sign below — using an intermediate CA on the signing host (kept offline). Posting for review:
```bash
# on node: generate private key + CSR
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -out node.key -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:3072
openssl req -new -key node.key -subj "/CN=kms-node-01.redwood.local" -out node.csr
# transfer node.csr to offline signing host (USB / secure transfer)
# on signing host (offline): sign using intermediate CA
openssl x509 -req -in node.csr -CA intermediate_ca.pem -CAkey intermediate_ca.key -CAcreateserial -out node.crt -days 3650 -sha256
# export chain
cat node.crt intermediate_ca.pem root_ca.pem > node.chain.pem
```

laura: good. add an example for importing the private key into an HSM (PKCS#11) and include SoftHSM example for labs. note that many HSMs *do not* allow import of private keys (they generate keys on-device) — add vendor caveat.

priya: SoftHSM import example (for lab/testing) + generic pkcs11 import command: 
```bash
# SoftHSM: import a PKCS8 private key (lab only)
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so --login --pin 1234 --write-object node.key --type privkey --label "kms-node-01"
# generic vendor: check vendor SDK for import steps; many HSMs require wrapped keys or in-device generation
```

mike: please include how to map key handles and labels post-import and how to query objects: 
```bash
# list objects and labels
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/libp11.so --login --pin 1234 --list-objects
```

sam: systemd unit suggestion for atomic install + restart. this should run the install script which validates chain, sets perms, and restarts the agent: 
```ini
[Unit]
Description=Apply KMS cert/key and restart redwood-kms-agent
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/apply-kms-credentials.sh /var/tmp/node.chain.pem /var/tmp/node.key
RemainAfterExit=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```
Make sure apply-kms-credentials.sh verifies the chain (openssl verify), sets owner redwood-kms:redwood-kms, chmod 0600, and performs an atomic move (mv to target path) so there is never a partial state. Also include a systemctl try-restart pattern in the script and a healthcheck (curl localhost:8080/health).

priya: adding verification/atomic steps and explicit rollback: preserve previous /etc/redwood-kms/{key,cert}.backup, on failure restore and restart. Also adding a test matrix for staging: 3-node rollout, one node failure mid-rollout, HSM import success/fail cases, and time-sync failure scenario.

ben: CRL/OCSP note: for offline customers we should recommend a short-lived cert strategy (rotate yearly) and provide an offline CRL generation recipe: 
```bash
# generate CRL on signing host
openssl ca -gencrl -config /etc/pki/ca.conf -out crl.pem
# export as DER if needed and distribute with transports (USB, config management)
openssl crl -in crl.pem -outform DER -out crl.der
```
Include instructions for placing CRL on a bastion or local cache and how the agent can be configured to check a local CRL file.

security: request to add explicit guidance for PIN/seed handling: do not store PINs in repo, recommend HSM OTP or hardware token for PIN entry, document required RBAC changes, and include an ACL example for which processes can access the PKCS#11 module. Also: add a short audit checklist (who performed signing, signature artifact storage location, checklist for secure transport of USB devices).

docs-bot: Reminder: run docs/linkcheck and docs/build workflows. Also run the new docs/lint rule for pkcs11 examples.

priya: added security notes, audit checklist, and updated PR description. small migration blurb for v1.2 -> v1.3: "v1.3 adds documented offsite signing workflow and example scripts; backport to v1.2 docs as patch if customers request." Sam: can you add a release-note blurb?

sam: release-note: "Private deploy: documented offsite signing workflow for HSM-backed KMS, including example pkcs11 commands, atomic install unit, and rollback steps." Also asked for a short YAML config example showing how to point the agent to a local CRL path and disable OCSP in fully airgapped installs.

laura: nit: prefer lowercase filenames in examples (intermediate_ca.pem, node.key). add links to PKCS#11 spec and SoftHSM docs. mention NTP/chrony requirement for cert checks in airgapped environments.

priya: addressed nits, pushed update to PR, and requested security approval (@security). Will wait for ack before merging. Thanks all :party-popper:
